commit.message:
wp433 P2c-C1: tren Windows credentials.json cua gws (W4, W5) chi ghi toi o cuc bo, ngoai kho git, khong xuyen lien ket

Dac ta GWS-CRED-DICH-NGOAI-KHO-C1 r1 (sha256 758782c72e86...), lease wp433-r4-g1-claude, Issue #433.

- M1 `_phan_loai_duong_nt(p)`: phan loai thuan (ntpath.splitdrive + regex, khong cham he tep). Nhan duong o
  co chu tuyet doi va duong tuong doi; tu choi theo thu tu NUL, trang, `\\?\`, `\\.\`, `\??\`, UNC, o tran,
  o tuong doi, goc o khong chu, o khac, `..`, ky tu cam / surrogate, cuoi cham-cach, ten thiet bi
  (ke ca COM0/LPT0, chu so mu, CONIN$/CONOUT$).
- M2 `_duong_dich_chuan_nt(p, cwd, loai_o=None)`: ghep THANH PHAN vao cwd; chi nhan loai o REMOVABLE (2) va
  FIXED (3) theo `GetDriveTypeW` nap luoi (`_loai_o_nt`); ly do mot dong `duong khong hop le: repr(x)[:200]`.
- M3 `_dich_cred_gws_nt`: nhanh `os.name != "posix"` cua `_dich_cred_gws` goi ham nay. Thu tu: chuan hoa;
  do `.git` ba trang thai tren chuoi tu vung; `_kiem_dich_ghi` tu goc o (lien ket o moi tien to, ke ca
  symlink treo); do `.git` tren chuoi that (`realpath(strict=True)` cua to tien gan nhat dang ton tai).
  Loi `lstat`/`realpath` ngoai "chua co" lan ra thanh `ghi loi` o W4/W5.
- M4: giu sau cum loi cua P2a, khong them cum; moi tu choi xay ra truoc writer.
- M5: fragment wp433_gws_cred_win_duong: 3 ca / 76 luot (47 + 18 + 11), 47 dot bien (39 moi nen, 8 chi nt),
  3 tu kiem phan hang, so luot va danh sach ID viet rieng.
- M6: tai sinh scripts/tl_test_fragments_bundled.py bang generate_bundled_module_bytes.

Khong sua than `_kiem_dich_ghi`, `_ghi_nguyen_tu_0600`, `_trong_kho_git`, `_duong_dich_chuan`; W4, W5 khong
doi. Ca `tich_hop_nt` va 8 dot bien nen nt CHUA chay tren Windows that (do native §4c do phien dieu phoi chay).

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
